text:
Type: large flatwoven area rug
Use: covering a dining or seating area; dining room, living room, kitchen
Style: minimalist, contemporary, industrial
Materials: tight synthetic-look flat weave, fine basket-weave texture
Colors: dark charcoal grey, black flecks
Shape: large rectangle with small checked weave texture, thin flat profile, plain edges, solid grounding visual weight
Feel: practical, understated, grounded
Goes with: light wood, white or grey walls, black metal, concrete; industrial, modern or minimalist dining and living rooms

product.name: MORUM
product.description: Ideal in your living room or under your dining table since the flat-woven surface makes it easy to pull out the chairs and vacuum.
